title: Cleaned NuSEDS spawner survey data linked to Conservation Units (PSF, 2026-02-20)
description: DFO NuSEDS escapement (spawner survey) records cleaned by the Pacific Salmon Foundation and matched to Conservation Units (cuid) and PSE stream IDs (streamid). One row per population x stream x year. Repackaged as a Salmon Data Package by the salmon-demo-corpus pipeline; values are unchanged from the source CSV apart from the derived column primary_enumeration_method. Table cu_year_spawners is a corpus-derived aggregate (sum of MAX_ESTIMATE by CU, year and estimate classification).
